dataset_version: CIFAR-10 python version 1700528161 (60000 32x32 color images, 10 mutually exclusive classes)
semantic_definition: One dominant CIFAR-10 object class per 32x32 image; a high-entropy sample is a candidate for cross-class feature fusion within a single subject, not a confirmed mixture and not legitimate multi-object coexistence.

pretraining_audit.evidence: CIFAR-10 photographs are 32x32 web-collected images labeled by the dataset authors and are not part of the ImageNet-1k training set used for evaluator initialization; this is a provenance declaration, not a membership verification.
